sloka: क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं वानरै सह ।त्वमध्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण ।। ६.१२५.२५ ।।
transliteration: kṣipramāroha sugrīva vimānaṁ vānarai saha ।tvamadhyāroha sāmātyo rākṣasendra vibhīṣaṇa ।। 6.125.25 ।।

translations.english: All the Vanaras and others having got into Kubera's Pushpaka with Rama's permission, it flew into the sky.
